messages:
harper: Noticed a tenant (vividly) saw a routing revert without a matching audit row around 02:12 UTC. trace t-8a1f.

noor: which flag? any agent involvement?

harper: flag routing.v3.priority. edge logs show `X-Apply-Mode: ephemeral` and response 200. control-plane audit has no row.

sam: sounds like the ephemeral apply path still returns 200 when audit store times out. We should fail-closed or at least surface headers.

noor: agree. short-term: add headers `X-Audit-Id` and `X-Audit-Retry-Token` to apply responses; make apply return 503 if audit write fails. long-term: reconciler that emits `orphaned_flag_change` events and a console CTA to backfill.

harper: also add telemetry `orphaned_runtime_changes_total{tenant}` and alert when >0 for 5m.

sam: can take backend patch. noor do console UX? need a CTA: 'Backfill Audit' (requires justification) and 'Revert Runtime'.

noor: will mock quick wireframes and API for evidence attach. ux-bot: created design task DT-2025-77.

devops-bot: Created incident INC-2025-399; owners sam (backend), noor (console), harper (incident lead). Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2025-399

harper: thanks. leaving notes on runbook: disable ephemeral applies by default and add runtime header `X-Audit-State: pending|written|failed` so SDKs can surface retry flows.
